text_block_list.text:
One of the races we've set our sights on
for the
year, the spring Tenno Sho, is
about to begin...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My hobbies include ballroom dancing,
ballet,
flower arrangement, and combat
sports!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
How lucky you are to be in the presence
of Gold
Ship, the refreshing, adorable,
and beautiful
Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I shall win with grace, as I
always do!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I don't know why she's talking like that,
but what
matters most is that she can't
wait to get started,
and that's a great
sign!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Let us have a good race, Golshi.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there you are! I had a feeling
you'd be here
when I heard I'd have to
go up against a tough
opponent!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not gonna go easy on you. Oh
no. Today,
I'm gonna really lay it on ya.
Like, just go
straight-up bonkers until—
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is that I'll be leaving
you in
the dust with my perfect and
brilliant strides!
Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Um, yes, well... I shall see you on the
track.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And so, the showdown with Эйсин Флэш
officially
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
